title: OpenBNCT benchmark and validation evidence catalogue
revision: fe3dd64 (handoff baseline); entries authored from committed case documentation

entries.title: Layered head phantom — 25³ synthetic head, skin/skull/brain, disk epithermal beam
entries.solver: S8 diamond-difference S_N; 28/56-group collapses from processed ENDF/B-VIII.1; OpenMC CE cross-check under intercomparison-layered-head
entries.uncertainty: Declared nuclear-data covariance propagated via `uq propagate` (boron MT=107 budget ~0.34% rel); per-voxel MC σ carried on dose bundles
entries.normalization: Absolute flux per source neutron; dose in Gy/source-particle

tolerances.criterion: order-of-magnitude axial agreement; 56g pathology flagged, not graded

evidence.label: frozen case + multi-collapse solves
evidence.note: Transported inputs, collapse scripts, and planning fixtures committed; group-condensation question arbitrated by the independent-engine leg (validation/intercomparison-layered-head)

limitations: synthetic phantom — no patient anatomy
56-group collapse produced deep-field pathology (resolved solver-side); see intercomparison entry

entries.solver: OpenMC continuous-energy ENDF/B-VIII.1, 600M histories/frozen seed; NJOY-processed ACE via transport/candidates

evidence.label: 600M-history acceptance report

evidence.label: frozen specification

limitations: single-code result; promotion requires independent reproduction

entries.title: NF-BNCT-003 — analytic pure-absorber slab (0.0253 eV beam into near-pure ¹⁰B)
entries.solver: deterministic S_N on declared one-group data; closed-form exp(−Σ_t·z) oracle
entries.uncertainty: analytic bound documented in oracle; multigroup covariance artifact present
entries.normalization: absolute; prefactor ties normalization to source/material constants

tolerances.criterion: 0.2308 cm⁻¹ analytic slope; S_N within 0.000% relative

evidence.label: PK washout scheduling on the slab phantom

limitations: idealized material — a code-verification oracle, not a tissue surrogate

entries.title: Scenario robust-planning oracle — degenerate four-voxel two-field case
entries.solver: worst-case-scenario optimizer vs closed-form optimum (w_h* = 1.498875, w_b* = 0)
limitations: degenerate fixture by construction — checks the optimizer path, not clinical planning
entries.uncertainty: closed-form optimum — deterministic check, no statistical uncertainty

entries.title: Reed (1971) heterogeneous 1-D slab — strong absorber/source, void gap, c=0.9
entries.solver: deterministic S_N vs Warsa (2002) eigenfunction expansion, 81 pointwise fluxes
limitations: angular-truncation peak deviation is documented, not hidden in the mean
entries.uncertainty: deterministic comparison — no measurement σ; angular-truncation deviation documented per region

evidence.label: quadrant-mean comparison
evidence.origin: Azmy 1988 published quadrant means; machine-precision quadrant symmetry

entries.uncertainty: deterministic comparison — machine-precision quadrant symmetry; no measurement σ

entries.title: Kobayashi (2001) nested-cubes void problem — pure absorber and 50% scattering
entries.solver: deterministic S8/S16; references: analytic ray integral + GMVP Monte Carlo table

tolerances.criterion: reported, not graded — S_N cannot resolve the void-shadow probes

evidence.label: case-i near-field probes
evidence.origin: cell-averaged analytic ray integrals, verified <0.14% vs COG LLNL-TR-648225

evidence.label: case-i deep-field ray-effect regime
evidence.region: deep field beyond the void shadow
evidence.note: severe deep-field discrepancies are the benchmark's purpose — the S16 sharpening signature is recorded, not graded as a pass

evidence.label: case-ii scattering probes
evidence.origin: GMVP Monte Carlo, NEA/NSC Kobayashi benchmark report (PNE 39:119-144 2001)

limitations: S_N ray effects dominate the deep field — kept visible as a separate region rather than averaged into one verdict
entries.uncertainty: analytic/GMVP references are exact-resolution; ray-effect regime documented separately, not averaged into the verdict

entries.title: Kobayashi P1-ii through OpenMC multigroup — independent-engine arbitration
entries.solver: OpenMC multigroup, 20M histories, same 2 cm lattice vs our S8

evidence.label: MC vs GMVP probe agreement and S_N ray-effect measurement
evidence.note: MC within ~1σ of GMVP at all probes; measures S_N −40% off-lobe underfill / +110–218% diagonal overshoot

limitations: quantifies the deterministic solver's angular artifact — not a pass/fail gate
entries.uncertainty: OpenMC 20M-history tally σ reported per probe; MC↔GMVP agreement ~1σ

entries.title: Layered-head phantom — S_N vs continuous-energy OpenMC
entries.solver: OpenMC CE ENDF/B-VIII.1 (400k pilot) vs S8 28g/56g

evidence.label: CE tallies vs S_N solves
evidence.note: 28g tracks CE within ~±30% axial flux; 56g overproduces deep flux 40–100× — the mechanism was resolved solver-side

limitations: pilot statistics (400k histories); production run budgeted at ~15–20M
entries.uncertainty: pilot 400k-history statistics: mid-head capture rel-err 2–9%, deepest axial ~18%

entries.title: FiR 1 K63 in the ~51 cm cubical water phantom (published reference geometry)
entries.solver: 20M-history OpenMC Monte Carlo; deterministic S8 28g TSL+P1 cross-check
entries.uncertainty: ±3% activation-foil uncertainty on source measurements; published anchors carry stated uncertainties
entries.normalization: advantage-depth / thermal-fluence-maximum anchors + digitized TECDOC-1223 depth shape — the cubical phantom differs from the measured Ø20 cm cylinder, so profile agreement is shape-level only

evidence.label: digitized TECDOC-1223 depth profile (shape comparison)
evidence.normalization: shape comparison only — phantom geometry differs from the measured cylinder; not an absolute-dose pass

evidence.label: S_N vs OpenMC gamma on the same phantom

limitations: cubical phantom cannot reproduce the measured small-cylinder tail — comparison is shape-level by construction
trace ¹⁰B/¹⁴N loading exists only for component-fold capability gating (~1e-5 relative effect)
